executiveSummary: Adversaries are actively targeting Siemens S7 PLCs using AI-assisted scripts and public S7 libraries to read/write logic over S7comm, elevating the risk of unsafe process changes across multiple U.S. critical infrastructure sectors. Security Advisory France experienced coordinated manipulation of internet-exposed industrial refrigeration controllers (Danfoss/Dixell/Copeland), with mass setpoint changes disrupting cold chains; similar exposures exist globally in food/pharma logistics. View Article Ivanti Connect Secure VPN zero-day (CVE-2026-104935) is under active exploitation enabling unauthenticated RCE and credential theft; immediate patching, factory reset/rebuild, and full credential rotation are urged. Security Advisory Supporting Report Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway vulnerabilities are being widely exploited; DTLS-enabled VPNs are particularly exposed. Organizations should patch immediately and assess for compromise. Security Advisory View Article OT gateways and drives with critical flaws: Advantech WISE-6610 and EKI-1242EIMS industrial gateways contain RCE and missing-auth functions; Danfoss iC7 drives allow unsigned firmware/apps via service interfaces-enabling device takeover and process disruption. Security Advisory Security Advisory Microsoft's October patch cycle shipped a record volume including an exploited Windows Shell SFB (CVE-2026-96951); prioritize patching HMIs/engineering workstations and domain controllers bridging IT-OT. View Article

items: Ransomware: Gunra affiliates exploit FortiGate/SSL-VPNs, perform AD takeover, exfiltrate, then encrypt-Linux variant has PRNG weakness for potential recovery. Security Advisory
APT/Intrusion: NightEagle leverages Exchange webshells, Microsoft dev tunnels, RDP/rdp2tcp, and DCSync to compromise AD and move laterally. View Article
Enterprise Domain Abuse: "PAYLOAD" incident weaponized GPOs for encryptionless extortion, disabling firewalls and pushing ransom notes fleetwide. View Article
ShinyHunters: Mass exploitation of Oracle PeopleSoft (CVE-2026-35273) with WAF bypass reported across sectors; risk to identity/HR systems at CI operators. View Article

relevance: The current threat picture combines direct device targeting (Siemens S7 PLCs) with a surge in exploited perimeter devices that underpin access into OT environments (Ivanti, NetScaler, F5). Real-world sabotage of refrigeration controllers underscores the operational impact potential when OT assets are internet-exposed or reachable from poorly segmented enterprise networks. Vulnerabilities in protocol gateways (Advantech) and motor drives (Danfoss iC7) increase the blast radius for adversaries who gain a foothold. Prioritize exposure elimination, strict IT/OT segmentation (ISA/IEC 62443), and rapid remediation of actively exploited edge devices.

Danfoss iC7 drives - unsigned app/firmware upload via service interfaces. Security Advisory

descriptions: Exploit Public-Facing Applications (ATT&CK T1190): Ivanti, NetScaler, F5, Nextcloud web shell drops
Valid Accounts & Credential Access (T1078, T1003): VPN/IdP abuse; Kerberoasting post-Ivanti compromise
Command and Scripting Interpreter (T1059): PowerShell/CMD in ransomware and APT intrusions; ClickFix chains (ROMULUS)
Web Shell (T1505.003) and Reverse Tunnels (rdp2tcp/dev tunnels) for lateral movement
AD/GPO Abuse (T1484): Domain-root GPO weaponization (encryptionless extortion)
ICS ATT&CK: Modify Controller Logic (T0831) and Unauthorized Command Message (T0828) on Siemens S7; Impair Process Control via gateway/drives misconfiguration

outlook72h: Expect sustained scanning and exploitation attempts against Ivanti and NetScaler as patch releases propagate; prioritize eviction and monitoring of VPN subnets. High likelihood of opportunistic attacks against exposed OT controllers following media/advisory coverage-reassess external exposure and firewall rules immediately. Windows exploitation of Shell SFB likely to rise via phishing; enforce ASR and accelerate patching on OT-adjacent Windows hosts. Track vendor updates for Advantech gateway and Danfoss iC7 mitigations; pre-stage rollback/config backups for rapid restoration.
